caption: The drawing shows a rail car with two sets of wheels on a track, viewed from the side. The body of the rail car is rectangular and has window sections and a door on the visible side. The words “BAYOU BRIDGE & CITY PARK” appear above the windows, and the letters “N O C R R C O” are written along the lower section. The rail car features two large, spoked mechanisms attached to either end, resembling paddle wheels, each with a central hub that is colored red. Attached to the top of the rail car are two crossed frameworks, resembling the structure for a large umbrella or canopy, with sections highlighted in light orange or tan. The drawing is rendered in pencil and ink with light washes of orange, red, and muted yellow for emphasis. The track below is lightly sketched, as is the ground, and the entire composition is centered on a plain, beige background.
title: Street Car
